description: Questions that need the live legal sources (L7): the current text of an article from wetten.overheid.nl, or published rulings from rechtspraak.nl. must_contain lists facts from the official texts as of November 2026 (each a list of accepted variants); cite is what the answer must name; host is where the cited source must come from.
